entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to an agent.
Hello, you're speaking with Isaac at VeloFit. How can I help you today?
Hi Isaac. I'm calling about an order I placed a little while ago. I need to return a jersey.
I can certainly look into that for you. To get started, what specifically is the issue with the jersey? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
It's a preference issue. I ordered the wrong size, and it's just too tight for a comfortable ride.
I understand completely. Getting the right fit is crucial. Do you have your order number handy?

Thank you. Let me pull that up... Okay, I see the order for the Pro-Line Jersey, delivered 63 days ago. Our policy for standard apparel allows for returns within 90 days, so you're well within the timeframe. We can definitely process this. Would you like a refund, or would you prefer an exchange for the correct size?
An exchange would be perfect. Now, since I'm going through the trouble of the exchange process, could you maybe offer a small credit or a discount code for my next purchase?

I'm happy we can get the right size sent out to you. While I can't add a discount for a standard size exchange, I can confirm the return shipping will be completely free of charge. I can generate that label and email it to you right now.
I appreciate the free shipping, but I am a regular customer. A small 15% off code seems reasonable for the hassle of having to call in and manage the return.

I do understand your position, and we value your business. However, our system doesn't allow for goodwill credits on standard policy returns. My priority is to make this exchange as seamless as possible for you. I've already set up the new order for the larger jersey, and it will ship as soon as we receive the original item.
Okay, that's fair. As long as the exchange is happening, that's the most important part. Thanks for processing it.
Of course. The return label is on its way to your inbox. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
You're welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
